case.title: Need an invoice copy with VAT number
case.subject: Invoice October with VAT ID
case.text:
Hello,

Please can you send me the October invoice with our VAT ID DE000000000 on it? Our tax advisor needs it.

Regards,
Thomas Müller
Praxis Müller
case.why: Invoices are self-serve in Settings → Billing → Invoices; VAT number in Billing details (applies to future invoices; past corrected copy via billing).

output.reply:
Hello Thomas,

Thanks for reaching out. I can't reissue invoices myself, but here is how it works. You can add your VAT number in Settings → Billing → Billing details. Please note this applies to future invoices only. For a corrected copy of a past invoice, such as October's, the billing team handles that. I'll pass your request to them so they can follow up with you about the October invoice with your VAT ID. I can't promise a timeline.

All your existing invoices can be downloaded as PDFs from Settings → Billing → Invoices.

Slotwise Support

raw.summary: Customer requests the October invoice reissued with their VAT ID added for their tax advisor.
reasons: Model suggests a human look: Reissuing an invoice with a VAT ID requires a billing agent to edit/regenerate it; VAT ID in message appears redacted/incomplete and needs verification.
